checks.name: row_count_positive
checks.expectation: row count must be greater than 0

checks.name: required_columns_present
checks.expectation: all required columns must exist: paper_id, title, summary, published, age_days, text_for_embedding

checks.name: paper_id_not_null
checks.expectation: missing or blank paper_id count must equal 0

checks.name: paper_id_unique
checks.expectation: rows participating in duplicate paper_id groups must equal 0
checks.details: Comparison is case-insensitive and ignores surrounding whitespace.

checks.name: title_not_empty
checks.expectation: missing or blank title count must equal 0

checks.name: summary_not_empty
checks.expectation: missing or blank summary count must equal 0

checks.name: text_for_embedding_not_empty
checks.expectation: missing or blank text_for_embedding count must equal 0

checks.name: summary_min_length
checks.expectation: every summary must contain at least 50 characters

checks.name: published_date_valid
checks.expectation: unparseable or missing published date count must equal 0

checks.name: age_days_valid
checks.expectation: age_days must be a non-negative number for every row
